cases.sentence: Пусть ___ Иуды будет под своим знаменем на востоке, к восходу.
cases.explain: «полковой лагерь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

cases.sentence: Пусть на юге будет ___ Рувима под своим знаменем.
cases.explain: «полковой лагерь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

cases.sentence: Пусть на западе будет ___ Ефрема под своим знаменем.
cases.explain: «полковой лагерь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

cases.sentence: Пусть на севере будет ___ Дана под своим знаменем.
cases.explain: «полковой лагерь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

cases.sentence: Лишь левиты не были исчислены с ___ — так повелел Моисею Господь.
cases.explain: «остальными израильтянами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
